methods.name: GetCountdownFromInstants
methods.description: Returns a list with the days, hours, minutes, and seconds between two dates. Arguments must be instants.

methods.name: GetCountdownFromStrings
methods.description: Returns a list with the days, hours, minutes, and seconds between two dates. Arguments must be formatted correctly like MM/DD/YYYY hh:mm:ss, or MM/DD/YYYY or hh:mm

methods.name: GetCurrentTimeAsString
methods.description: Returns the current time as a suitable String to be used with the GetCountdownFromStrings function. The returned string is in the format MM/DD/YYYY HH:mm:ss

methods.name: GetDurationInDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days between given start date and end date. Arguments must be formatted correctly like MM/DD/YYYY hh:mm:ss, or MM/DD/YYYY or hh:mm

methods.name: GetDurationInHours
methods.description: Returns the number of hours between given start date and end date. Arguments must be formatted correctly like MM/DD/YYYY hh:mm:ss, or MM/DD/YYYY or hh:mm

methods.name: GetDurationInMinutes
methods.description: Returns the number of minutes between given start date and end date. Arguments must be formatted correctly like MM/DD/YYYY hh:mm:ss, or MM/DD/YYYY or hh:mm

methods.name: GetDurationInMonths
methods.description: Returns the number of months between given start date and end date. Arguments must be formatted correctly like MM/DD/YYYY hh:mm:ss, or MM/DD/YYYY or hh:mm

methods.name: GetDurationInSeconds
methods.description: Returns the number of seconds between given start date and end date. Arguments must be formatted correctly like MM/DD/YYYY hh:mm:ss, or MM/DD/YYYY or hh:mm

methods.name: GetDurationInWeeks
methods.description: Returns the number of weeks between given start date and end date. Arguments must be formatted correctly like MM/DD/YYYY hh:mm:ss, or MM/DD/YYYY or hh:mm

methods.name: GetDurationInYears
methods.description: Returns the number of years between given start date and end date. Arguments must be formatted correctly like MM/DD/YYYY hh:mm:ss, or MM/DD/YYYY or hh:mm

name: countdown
helpString: This extension provides methods to more easily calculate the duration between two dates, the methods GetCountdownFromStrings, and GetCountdownFromInstants return a countdown as a YailList and can be easily called to retrieve the number of days, hours, minutes, and seconds remaining.
